description: This file defines the SaveQualificationLanguageController class in the OrangeHRM Admin plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and manages the pre-render setup for qualification language editing or saving, depending on the presence of an 'id' attribute in the request.

classes.name: SaveQualificationLanguageController
classes.description: Controller managing the rendering logic for qualification language editing/saving interface.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component based on whether an 'id' attribute exists in the request; sets up the component accordingly.
